See docs/migration/.

post.summary: Redeem an operator-issued password reset code
post.description: MAZ-123, .NET backend only (Node does not implement it). A server operator issues a single-use code with the `reset-password EMAIL` maintenance command and delivers it out of band; there is no email delivery. Redeeming it stores the new password as an ASP.NET Core Identity hash and revokes every session of the account; no session is issued, so the user then signs in normally. The request names no email, so responses never reveal whether an account exists. Unknown, malformed, used, superseded and expired codes share one 400 message. Shares the sign-in rate limit; the origin policy applies. See docs/migration/authentication.md#password-reset.

200.description: Password replaced and all sessions revoked.

400.description: `This reset code is invalid or has expired.` for any unusable code, `Enter a password of 10–256 characters.` for an invalid password (the code stays usable), or `Invalid JSON.`
